papers.title: Illusion Momentum and Cross-Sectional Returns
papers.key_finding: New cross-sectional momentum signal: ILLUSION = arithmetic_sum(r) − compound_return. Gap is always ≥0 (Jensen's inequality) and grows with variance. Stocks with high illusion momentum earn superior future returns. Mechanism: investor cognitive bias — mistaking cumulative-sum for cumulative return. Confirmed in Japanese AND US markets, stronger in bear markets and large-cap. Paper is behind paywall (ScienceDirect); abstract via IDEAS/RePEC.

papers.title: HedgeAgents: A Multi-Agent Trading System with Central Fund Manager and Specialized Hedging Experts
papers.key_finding: Multi-agent system: central fund manager allocates budget across specialized hedging experts (momentum, mean-reversion, macro). Claims ~70% annualized return — highly suspicious and likely backtested on favorable period. No out-of-sample discipline described. Architecture is interesting but performance claims not credible without rigorous OOS validation.
papers.reason_not_staged: 70% annualized return claim is a red flag — likely data-snooping or in-sample overfit. No OOS discipline described. H274 multi-agent upgrade already staged with more rigorous framework. Architecture pattern (fund manager + specialist agents) is consistent with H318 meta-agent framework already in hypothesis log.

papers.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical RL for Pair Trading
papers.key_finding: LLM selects semantically coherent pairs, RL learns trading rules. H316 STUB already covers this.
papers.reason_not_staged: Already documented as H316 STUB. No new implementation information found.

papers.title: Semantic Trading: Agentic AI for Clustering and Portfolio Management
papers.key_finding: Agentic AI using semantic clustering for portfolio construction. 2025 paper, not actionably different from existing H319 (LLM semantic network).
papers.reason_not_staged: H319 (LLM semantic network arXiv:2604.19476) already covers semantic relationship discovery. This 2025 paper predates H319 and is less rigorous.

papers.title: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
papers.key_finding: Constrained LLM agents for factor discovery in crypto markets. Implements hypothesis-to-factor pipeline with constraints on signal realism.
papers.reason_not_staged: Crypto market, not equity. H382 (FactorEngine) and H381 (AlphaLogics) already staged as more rigorous equity-focused LLM factor mining approaches. Crypto universe does not transfer to H198.

papers.title: Cross-Sectional Stock Return Predictability: A Machine Learning Approach
papers.key_finding: Industry-adjusted short-term reversal signal 0.53%/month globally. Already documented as H181 proposed direction in hypothesis log.
papers.reason_not_staged: H181 already proposed and documented. H313 (sector-neutral momentum) tested the related sector-neutral concept and was NOT CONFIRMED on US large-cap. H181 (industry-adjusted reversal) remains unrun but is in the queue.

scan_notes: Thinner scan than 2026-07-07 (which staged 6 proposals). The main waves of LLM+alpha papers from March-May 2026 (AlphaLogics, FactorEngine, HMM+RL, ReCAP) were all caught in the prior scan. Tonight's best find is Illusion Momentum — a behaviorally-motivated, zero-cost, US-large-cap confirmed signal that is mechanically orthogonal to H377 and could form a composite. PEAD angle came up empty for new 2026 papers beyond what was staged previously (SAE-FiRE, H375 GradPerp). Multi-agent angle: HedgeAgents claim is suspicious — not worth staging without rigorous OOS evidence.
